verdict.rationale: First-party docs show self-serve forwarding of letters and packages, domestic or international, requested "with a few taps" from the phone app or web portal, so the operator does not need to email support. Nothing in the evidence covers the story's specific elements: rule-based or automatic forwarding, saved forwarding addresses, carrier selection, or a cost estimate shown before confirming. Missing for 10: rule-based/automatic forwarding, saved forwarding recipients/addresses, carrier choice, pre-confirmation cost display, independent or hands-on corroboration.
